summary: An agent has no memory of your project between sessions, so you write an instructions file: tested commands, layout, concrete rules, what done means and what to ask first, short, true and without secrets. CLAUDE.md imports AGENTS.md. You test every command and try the file on a new agent session.
goal: Write the instructions file for your repo.

items.text: Write AGENTS.md with the six parts and a one-line CLAUDE.md
Run every command in the file and fix what fails
Cut every line a new colleague would not need, aim for under 60 lines
Start a new agent session with a task that touches one of your rules and note what it missed
Play the Instructions File game to the end and see your score
